facts.claim: 1923년 힐 하늘 렌즈 — 구름 조사, 첫 어안 렌즈로 꼽힘
facts.note: In 1924, Robin Hill first described a lens with 180° coverage that had been used for a cloud survey in September 1923 ... The Hill Sky Lens is now credited as the first fisheye lens.
followed by a commercial release as the Nikon Fisheye Camera ... in September 1960 ... Only 30 examples of the Nikon Fisheye Camera were manufactured, and of those, 18 were sold to customers
The term fisheye was coined in 1906 by American physicist and inventor Robert W. Wood

facts.claim: 물 채운 통 바닥 사진판·바늘구멍 실험 논문
facts.note: In 1906, Wood published a paper detailing an experiment in which he built a camera in a water-filled pail starting with a photographic plate at the bottom, a short focus lens with a pinhole diaphragm ... the title of the paper was "Fish-Eye Views, and Vision under Water".

question.hintNote: Bond described an improvement to Wood's apparatus in 1922 which replaced the tank of water with a simple hemispheric glass lens, making the camera significantly more portable.
